title: Two Critical Reasons Why We Can't Use GEX For Predictions
text: So, the two inputs that ultimately make GEX a prediction are the ones that nobody can observe. The sign, whether or not somebody is long or short an option and thus the dealer is long or short GEX, nobody has insight to. Second thing is the way that dealers hedge, their hedging behavior. That's what leads to the perceived effect on markets. And again, the massive gap here is that there's a huge, huge difference between the way that methodology requires dealers to hedge in order for GEX to be viable versus something else.
